name: scroll-area
title: Scroll area
description: A scrolling region whose edges fade where content continues, and that can follow what arrives at its end.
use: A region that scrolls inside the page: a long list in a panel, a wide table, a log. Give it a height or a maximum height, and tabindex="0", a role and a label unless it holds focusable content. A region that grows at its end while it is read (a chat, a build log, a streamed answer) takes role="log" and the follow behavior, which keeps the end in view until the reader scrolls away.

instead.when: The row of items snaps from one slide to the next
Two regions share the space and each scrolls by itself

keyboard.keys: ArrowUp, ArrowDown, PageUp, PageDown, Home, End
keyboard.action: Scroll the focused region, as the browser does
With the follow behavior: scrolling toward the start stops following and shows the scroll-area-latest button
With the follow behavior: back at the end, the region follows again
On scroll-area-latest: scroll to the end and follow again, as a button does

platform.fallback: The region scrolls the same and its edges stay clean, with no fade
The follow behavior keeps the reader's place itself when content is inserted above it

classes.name: scroll-area
classes.description: A region that scrolls along the block axis, with a thin scrollbar and edges that fade where content continues

classes.name: scroll-area-inline
classes.description: Scrolls along the inline axis and fades the start and end edges

classes.name: scroll-area-latest
classes.description: On a btn after the region's content: the way back to the end of a region that follows. Sticky at the foot over the content, above the fade; the behavior gives it hidden while the region follows

states.name: following
states.description: The region follows its end, so the way back to it is hidden

properties.name: --scroll-area-fade
properties.description: Length of the fade at each edge

example:
2.1 adds overlays that need no script.

Dialogs open with invoker commands and trap focus on their own.

Popovers, menus and tooltips are placed with anchor positioning and flip at the viewport edge.
